text: For a flag, write a function with signature `func(cmd *Command, args []string, toComplete string) ([]string, ShellCompDirective)` and register it with `cmd.RegisterFlagCompletionFunc(flagName, fn)` (`completions.go:133-134`). For positional arguments use `ValidArgsFunction`; both mechanisms are portable across Bash, Zsh, Fish, and PowerShell (`site/content/completions/_index.md:477-479`).
